interpretation.amplitude: how much same-state phylogenetic memory is retained overall across resolutions
interpretation.scale_tilt: whether retained memory is displaced toward fine versus coarse phenotype representation
interpretation.intermediate_curvature: whether the intermediate representation contributes a distinct bulge beyond the coarse-fine line

orthogonal_variance_basis.primary_summary: fraction of centered between-clade sum of squares on each fixed axis

tests: Spearman amplitude versus fine-color persistence slope
Spearman amplitude versus fine-color persistence area
Spearman scale_tilt versus fine-color persistence slope
Spearman scale_tilt versus fine-color persistence area
temporal_bridge.interpretation_rule: amplitude may be called a temporal-memory-strength axis only if it has the expected negative association with decay slope and positive association with persistence area; scale_tilt is interpreted as a separate axis only if it is not comparably coupled to those temporal summaries

secondary_geometry.purpose: test whether profile shape varies more along coarse-fine tilt than through an intermediate-specific bulge

claim_boundary: does not add independent biological replication
does not alter frozen EL v0.3
fixed axes are algebraic coordinates, not latent causes
temporal correlations reuse the same source states and phylogenies
